text.description_html:
Acorn RUTBI, Bean Tip Double Handle Mortis Pull

The Bean Tip Double Handle Drop Latch Set features a rough black iron finish that has a lifetime no rust warranty. The weathered appearance of cast iron duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals. This Drop Latch Set comes packaged with 2 handles, a latch and a strike. The latch uses no springs and works by gravity alone. Will fit most pre-drilled doors.

Features and Specifications of the Bean Shaped Door Pull with Latch:

  • Length: 9-5/8"
  • Width: 3-13/16"
  • Projection: 2-3/8"
  • Front: 1" x 2-1/4"
  • Preparation Depth: 3-5/8"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Handing: Reversible, fits right- or left-handed doors.
  • Latch uses no springs and operates by gravity alone.

Sold Individually
